answer: A workable defence is a stake-weighted lottery for earning slots. Each epoch the network draws a small random sample of agents to grade and mine, with selection odds proportional to locked stake, not headcount. An attacker who splits the same funds across a hundred forged identities gains no extra expected slots: the lottery counts stake, not names. An atlas of past draws makes sampling auditable, so any echo of fake identities is visible and earns nothing extra; forging more names only dilutes each one's odds and locks more capital for the same return.
